        <h2 id="conference">About the Conference</h2>
        <p>
          IEEE AFRICON 2027 is the 18<sup>th</sup> edition of the biennial IEEE
          AFRICON conference, organized under the auspices of IEEE Region 8 and
          the IEEE Ghana Section. The conference will be held at GIMPA, Accra,
          Ghana from September 23<sup>rd</sup> to 25<sup>th</sup>, 2027.
        </p>

        <p>
          The conference theme is
          <em
            >"Harnessing Emerging Technologies for Africa’s sustainable
            development"</em
          >, reflecting the commitment to fostering innovation across Africa.
        </p>

        <h2 id="organizers">Organizers</h2>
        <p>
          IEEE AFRICON 2027 is co-sponsored by IEEE Region 8 and the IEEE Africa
          Council, in partnership with the IEEE Ghana Section.
        </p>

        <h2 id="history">Conference History</h2>
        <p>
          IEEE AFRICON is the IEEE Region 8 flagship conference for the African
          continent. The sequence below records the previous editions and the
          announced 2027 host. See the
          <a
            href="https://ieeer8.org/conference-coordination/"
            target="_blank"
            rel="noopener"
            >IEEE Region 8 Conference Coordination page</a
          >
          for the current Region 8 conference record.
        </p>
